title: orthochilus aculeatus subsp. huttonii
intro: Orthochilus aculeatus subsp. huttonii, commonly known as Hutton's Lip Orchid, is a plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hutton's Lip Orchid include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which may contribute to its use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
